opening.argument: The AVAX analysis presents a possible rise above $100 as a conditional scenario, not a certain outcome. Even when the speaker describes the reward-to-risk ratio as more favorable for long positions, the discussion expressly says that does not mean it is the right time to buy and leaves that decision to each viewer’s trading strategy. The description also frames the material as informational and educational. Taken together, those qualifications support reading the video as market analysis rather than a directive to purchase.
